Navigate to the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} object in Setup. 2. Click **Field Sets**. 3. Click **Edit** next to Virtual Terminal. 4. Remove, add, and modify the fields within that box to fit your use case. *Fields "In the Field Set" box are the fields currently on the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}}'s Transaction screen.* 6. Click **Save**. ![VT Transaction Configuration_1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/VT%20Transaction%20Configuration_1.png){height="" width=""} ![VT Transaction Configuration_2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/VT%20Transaction%20Configuration_2.png){height="" width=""}
